conflicts.evidence_span_a: Carrier invoices can be disputed within 30 days of delivery.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: The dispute window for carrier invoices is 45 days from the invoice date.
conflicts.rationale: Finance Ops Month-End Close policy defines the dispute window for financial settlement.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Cycle counts run nightly for A-class SKUs.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: A-class SKUs are cycle counted weekly.
conflicts.rationale: Inventory Accuracy Standard cites accepted ADR-77 for distribution center counting.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Proof of delivery customer signature is optional since v4.2.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Proof of delivery customer signature is strictly mandatory for every drop-off.
conflicts.rationale: Fleet Safety Policy governs legal compliance for cargo delivery.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Tier 1 systems have a 15 minute acknowledgement target for on-call engineers.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Tier 1 systems have a 5 minute acknowledgement target for on-call engineers.
conflicts.rationale: Platform On-call Rotation Guide reflects agreed platform incident management policy.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Customer damage claims under 250 USD are approved automatically without human review.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Customer damage claims under 400 USD are approved automatically without human review.
conflicts.rationale: Authority Matrix reflects latest financial authorization thresholds under ADR-87.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Reefer loads that stay above 8 degrees C for more than 30 minutes are rejected at the receiving dock.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: A reefer load is rejected once it has spent 15 minutes above 8 degrees C at any point after pickup.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-88 supersedes ADR-41; traversal walks SUPERSEDES backwards to accept the 15-minute standard.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Drivers are blocked from accepting new loads after 11 hours of driving in a shift.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: No driver may drive more than 10 hours in a shift across all lanes.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-74 supersedes ADR-30; the 10-hour ceiling is the legally active safety rule.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: External routing solver calls are retried up to 3 times before fallback.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: External routing solver calls are retried exactly 1 time to prevent cascade timeouts.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-52 supersedes ADR-18; single retry prevents downstream cascading queue delays.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Carriers arriving within 60 minutes of scheduled slot retain dock priority.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Carriers arriving more than 30 minutes late lose dock appointment and are rescheduled.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-68 supersedes ADR-22; tightened grace period reduces yard congestion.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Tractors transmit GPS telematics ping every 15 seconds while moving.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Tractors transmit GPS telematics ping every 30 seconds while moving to conserve cellular bandwidth.
conflicts.rationale: ADR-49 supersedes ADR-12; 30-second interval balances tracking fidelity and cellular data cost.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: If the routing API does not respond within 10 seconds, Dispatch Router falls back to manual dispatch.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: We cut the router timeout to 4 seconds last sprint and it now retries on the backup solver automatically without manual dispatch fallback.
conflicts.rationale: Operational chat consensus records production change to 4s automated fallback without manual console.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Customs Gateway files import declarations automatically 24 hours before scheduled arrival.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Gateway auto-filing has been switched off since August and brokerage is filing declarations manually.
conflicts.rationale: Brokerage team chat confirms automated filing disabled following certificate expiration.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: Payments Gateway caches settlement idempotency keys for 24 hours.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Payment idempotency key retention was increased to 72 hours following the double-charge incident.
conflicts.rationale: Urgent engineering chat hotfix extended payment key retention to 72 hours.

conflicts.evidence_span_a: If the primary reefer probe and secondary logger disagree by more than 1.5 degrees C, open a hardware ticket.
conflicts.evidence_span_b: Reefer probe calibration tolerance was tightened to 0.5 degrees C following the dairy shipment audit.
conflicts.rationale: Quality audit in chat tightened variance threshold to 0.5 degrees C.
